name: Oreo Truffles
desc: Crushed Oreos and cream cheese rolled into balls and dipped in semisweet chocolate.

source.title: Oreo Cookie Balls Recipe
source.evidence: Same three ingredients in the same amounts (16 oz Oreos, 8 oz cream cheese, 16 oz semi-sweet baking chocolate) and the same 9 reserved cookies, 42 balls and 1 hour chill; the wording traces to Kraft's OREO Cookie Balls.

ingredients.raw: 1 (16 oz) package Oreo chocolate sandwich cookies (about 45 cookies), divided
1 (8 oz) package full-fat brick cream cheese, softened
2 (8 oz) packages semisweet baking chocolate (such as Baker's), chopped and melted

steps: Crush 9 of the cookies to fine crumbs in a food processor (or in a zip-top bag with a rolling pin) and set aside for topping.
Crush the remaining 36 cookies to fine crumbs and put them in a medium bowl. Add the cream cheese and mix until completely blended.
Roll the mixture into 42 balls, about 1 inch across.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring between each, until smooth.
Dip the balls in the chocolate and set on a wax paper-lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with the reserved crumbs before the chocolate sets.
Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator.
tips: Leftover melted chocolate keeps at room temperature for another use.
